change_summary: Repaired news_propagation_pair_paper_sleeve.load_pair_bars so a warehouse frame whose last bar precedes the session anchor's (SPY) last warehouse bar is treated as absent and the whole ticker falls through to massive_history (raw bars + split normalization unchanged). Root cause reproduced read-only: ohlcv_overlay frames for non-core exposure tickers stop at 2026-04-24 (100 rows) while massive_history holds bars through 2026-09-11, so every pending basket reported missing_leg_bars for tickers that were actually priceable. Outcome-blind identity projection of the 5 pending baskets: missing tickers 45 -> 15; warehouse-shadowed legs (massive covers exit session) 31 -> 1, and that residual (BMHL) is a genuine missing 2026-08-28 entry-session bar in massive, not shadowing; 7 legs absent from every source (BAO, DBIM, EVON, HWEP + OTC ABIT/FMHS with no bars) and 7 delisted/stale legs remain fail-closed by the frozen missing-leg rule. 10/10 sleeve tests (1 new) + 2 run.py wiring tests pass. No basket PnL read; trade_enabled=false.
hypothesis: The news-propagation pair paper sleeve cannot settle any basket because load_pair_bars treats a stale warehouse frame (ohlcv_overlay rows for non-core tickers stop at 2026-04-24 with 100 rows) as present and therefore never consults the massive_history fallback that holds current bars for those tickers; the frozen rule is warehouse first then massive_history for tickers the warehouse cannot price. Repair: a warehouse frame whose last bar precedes the session anchor's last warehouse bar is treated as absent for that ticker so the whole ticker falls through to massive_history (raw bars plus split normalization, unchanged). Acceptance is correct implementation of the frozen rule verified by a unit test with an injected stale frame and a temporary massive db plus an outcome-blind identity projection of the five pending baskets (blocker kinds and missing-ticker counts only; no PnL read); it is not judged by any settled value.
notes: Implementation-error repair of the frozen warehouse-first/massive-fallback pricing rule; no contract parameter (H10, 45bp/leg, USD 1000/leg, 40% cap, fail-closed missing leg, acceptance >=20 baskets / >=10 dates) changed. HONEST RESIDUAL: after the repair 0/5 pending baskets are settleable because every basket (incl. the 3 still inside H10) contains at least one leg ticker with no price source anywhere (sic_peer_index-derived symbols BAO/DBIM/EVON/HWEP/GTIJF absent from massive instrument_master; ABIT/FMHS are OTC Link with zero bars; AIEV/BINI/ECDA were delisted before their decision dates). Under the frozen fail-closed missing-leg rule the sleeve therefore cannot produce forward evidence until admission gains an outcome-blind priceability condition; that is a contract amendment requiring its own registered contract-review ticket (next unit), not part of this single-variable repair. Frozen decisions are never rewritten. Applies automatically in the next daily run.py pass; no production smoke run performed to avoid mutating the daily-owned ledger/summary outside run.py.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not mix warehouse and massive bars within one ticker (split double-adjustment risk), do not relax the fail-closed missing-leg rule at settlement, do not backfill or rewrite the five frozen basket decisions, do not hand-price OTC/absent legs, and do not read basket PnL to decide which legs to drop.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A separately registered contract review adding an outcome-blind leg priceability condition to admission (bar existence on the sessions strictly before entry, warehouse-or-massive) plus a grace-bounded terminal 'unsettleable' disposition for window-complete baskets with permanently unpriceable legs; forward evidence counting for the frozen acceptance contract (>=20 settled baskets / >=10 dates) starts only from baskets admitted under that condition.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The frozen pricing rule (warehouse first, massive_history for tickers the warehouse cannot price) was implemented as 'warehouse frame non-empty => use it', but ohlcv_overlay only holds a stale 100-row window (2025-12-01..2026-04-24) for non-core exposure tickers, so 31 of 45 missing legs across the two H10-complete baskets were priceable in massive yet never looked up. Treating a frame that ends before the anchor's last warehouse bar as absent removes all shadowing (31 -> 0 shadowed; the one residual BMHL lacks a massive entry-session print). The repair cannot make any basket settle because every pending basket also holds legs with no price source anywhere; that is a contract gap, not this bug.
